subject: Re: Air freight quote to TLV
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for the update! We had to cancel the shipment after our buyer withdrew the order, so thanks for taking care of the booking and pickup.

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The customer acknowledges the cancellation update and thanks us, without asking for further action or information.
